name: get_portfolio_positions
description: Get all current positions in a portfolio from the demo trading system: symbol, quantity, cost basis, market value, unrealized P&L, plus portfolio totals.

name: calculate_pnl
description: Calculate profit and loss for a portfolio over a period (today/week/month/quarter/ytd/year) including unrealized P&L, dividends, and period return.

period.description: One of: today, week, month, quarter, ytd, year; Default: month

name: get_portfolio_allocation
description: Get the portfolio's sector allocation breakdown with concentration metrics (top position weight, Herfindahl index) computed from live demo positions.

name: suggest_rebalancing
description: Suggest trades to move the portfolio toward a target sector allocation. Provide target_allocation as a JSON object mapping sector name to target percent, e.g. {"Technology": 30, "Healthcare": 20}.

target_allocation.description: JSON object of sector name to target percent
